description: Eight free running analogue triangle LFOs under one rate control

params.text: Sets the frequency of all eight LFOs at once: fully clockwise the fastest reaches 160Hz, fully anticlockwise the slowest takes about 25 minutes for a cycle
Attenuates and inverts the rate CV input

inputs.text: Shifts the rate of all eight LFOs, scaled by its attenuverter; enough negative voltage stalls them, holding their last voltage

outputs.text: The fastest of the eight LFOs, a bipolar triangle wave at 10Vpp reaching 160Hz with RATE fully clockwise
The second fastest of the eight LFOs, a bipolar triangle wave at 10Vpp
The third of the eight LFOs, a bipolar triangle wave at 10Vpp
The fourth of the eight LFOs, a bipolar triangle wave at 10Vpp
The fifth of the eight LFOs, a bipolar triangle wave at 10Vpp
The sixth of the eight LFOs, a bipolar triangle wave at 10Vpp
The seventh of the eight LFOs, a bipolar triangle wave at 10Vpp
The slowest of the eight LFOs, a bipolar triangle wave at 10Vpp, taking about 25 minutes for a cycle with RATE fully anticlockwise
